measureExpressions.ns_daily_ebnotes.E-Bill %:
VAR AxisYear =
			    COALESCE (
			        SELECTEDVALUE ( 'ns_total_bills_monthly'[gl_year] ),
			        SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Ebill Account Month'[year] ),
			        SELECTEDVALUE ( 'ns_daily_ebnotes'[year] )
			    )
			
			VAR AxisMonth =
			    COALESCE (
			        SELECTEDVALUE ( 'ns_total_bills_monthly'[gl_month] ),
			        SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Ebill Account Month'[month] ),
			        SELECTEDVALUE ( 'ns_daily_ebnotes'[month] )
			    )
			
			VAR AxisMonthKey =
			    AxisYear * 100 + AxisMonth
			
			VAR AllEBillAccounts =
			    CALCULATE (
			        COUNTROWS ( 'Ebill Account Month' ),
			        REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Ebill Account Month' ),
			        'Ebill Account Month'[Bill Month Key] = AxisMonthKey
			    )
			
			VAR TotalMonthlyBills =
			    CALCULATE (
			        SUM ( 'ns_total_bills_monthly'[bills] ),
			        REMOVEFILTERS ( 'ns_total_bills_monthly' ),
			        'ns_total_bills_monthly'[Bill Month Key] = AxisMonthKey
			    )
			
			RETURN
			IF (
			    ISBLANK ( AxisYear ) || ISBLANK ( AxisMonth ),
			    BLANK (),
			    100 * DIVIDE ( AllEBillAccounts, TotalMonthlyBills, 0 )
			)
		lineageTag: c3a86e36-b72d-4a9e-acd2-d3d25bcbc477
measureExpressions.requests_dev.WoWChange_AvgResolve:
VAR CurrentWeekTotal =
			    [Avg_Resolve]  -- your base measure
			VAR PreviousWeekTotal =
			    CALCULATE(
			        [Avg_Resolve],
			        FILTER(
			            ALL( 'requests_dev' ),                      -- Use your new date table/hierarchy
			            'requests_dev'[Year] = MAX( 'requests_dev'[Year] )
			                && 'requests_dev'[Month_Name] = MAX( 'requests_dev'[Month_Name] )
			                && 'requests_dev'[Week] = MAX( 'requests_dev'[Week] ) - 1
			        )
			    )
			RETURN
			IF(
			    NOT ISBLANK( CurrentWeekTotal )
			        && NOT ISBLANK( PreviousWeekTotal ),
			    CurrentWeekTotal - PreviousWeekTotal,
			    BLANK()
			)
		formatString: 0
		lineageTag: 1c9ce5a1-281c-40ad-8084-8ab9903571e1
